name: Conformal Familiarity Metrology

selection.non_duplicate_reason: The recent Proof-Carrying Adaptive State field governs whether adaptive state is promotable after evaluation. This field instead measures whether a visual familiarity/open-set decision is statistically valid enough to justify fast-path routing. They couple at promotion/receipt boundaries but test different failure modes.

research_question: What statistical measurement receipt is sufficient to justify FRANK's KNOWN_HIGH_CONFIDENCE visual fast path without converting familiarity into sensor truth?

hypotheses.claim: Versioned calibration/risk receipts can make the familiar fast path more measurable and falsifiable than an unqualified confidence threshold.

counterhypotheses.claim: Known-only conformal/coverage calibration is not sufficient for open-set safety under overlapping or shifted unknowns.
Unknown-negative calibration remains scoped to its calibration distribution and can fail under shifted near-manifold unknowns.

negative_results.claim: Known-class confidence or known-only conformal coverage cannot be promoted to a general open-set safety guarantee for FRANK's user-adaptive visual learner.

cross_connections.delta: Represent calibration validity, domain/version, unknown-risk evidence, stale/conflict state and replay receipts using existing typed semantics first; no language redesign without executable counterexample.
Preserve measured value != inferred claim != evidence status != authority for familiarity calibration receipts.
Fast-path routing requires classifier result plus calibration validity/open-set evidence/provenance/conflict gates; invalid or shifted state escalates to deeper Retina.
Extend MVC-E5 with near-manifold unknown confusers, calibration-to-test distribution shift, stale calibration/version invalidation and compute-vs-abstention tradeoffs.
Persist calibration/classifier/backbone version, calibration domain/hash/age/validity lineage and rollback links when those stages materialize the learner state.

integration_result.reason: Synthetic falsification plus external statistical-method evidence; no real FRANK embedding/hardware test yet.
